text.description_html:
Acorn AMPBP, Black Iron Heart Doorbell Button Plate

The Heart Bell Button is great for rustic decor--a perfect selection for cabins and other charming homes. The Black Iron Heart Doorbell Button Plate has a no rust finish warranty. It comes packaged with the heart shaped rose, the replacement bell button and the installation screws. The Electric Bell Button is 1-7/8 inches x 1-3/4 inches.

Please Note This is a replacement trim only. It comes packaged with button, rosette, and installation screws. It DOES NOT include the chime.

Specifications for the Acorn AMPBP Heart Doorbell Button:

  • Material: Iron
  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Plate Height: 1-3/4"
  • Plate Width: 1-7/8"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
